#### ACS Data Overlook

The data that I pulled from the ACS is 2024 Median Household Income in King County, Washington State. The depth for data is based on census tract.

```{r}
  MedianHHInc <- get_acs(geography = "tract", table = "B19013", state = "53", county = "033", year = 2024, label = TRUE)

  write_csv(MedianHHInc, "MedianHHInc.csv")
  
```

#### Statistical Summary

```{r}
  class(MedianHHInc$estimate)
  mean(MedianHHInc$estimate, na.rm = TRUE)
  min(MedianHHInc$estimate, na.rm = TRUE)
  max(MedianHHInc$estimate, na.rm = TRUE)
  quantile(MedianHHInc$estimate, na.rm = TRUE)
```

It can be summarized from the basic descriptive analysis for 2024 Median Household Income in King County, Washington State :

1.  The average Median Household Income in King County, Washington is \$135,814
2.  The Lowest Median Household Income in King County, Washington is \$17,500
3.  The Highest Median Household Income in King County, Washington is \$25,000
4.  The average Median Household Income in King County falls just below on the upper quantile ( 75% is approximately around \$166,921).
